notes: The strongest Unity vertical in Portugal by far. Miniclip (Lisbon) is one of the largest mobile game studios in the world and the single biggest Unity employer in the country; also Kwalee PT, Bica Studios, Fun Punch. Live-ops and F2P monetisation experience carries the biggest premium

Portugal has a licensed online gambling market and a large operator tech hub — Kaizen Gaming (Betano) runs sizeable Lisbon/Porto engineering teams, plus Solverde and B2B suppliers. Unity used for casino/slot clients. Pays close to mobile F2P but with fewer Unity-specific seats

Portugal's console/PC scene is small and growing (Nerd Monkeys, Sandbox/indie cluster in Braga and Lisbon) with no true AAA studio. Passion-driven pay — typically below the mobile and iGaming verticals. Limited public bands

Stronger here than in most of the region — Critical Software (Coimbra) and aerospace/defence/health-training suppliers use Unity for simulators. Stable, contract-funded work; pay near the market median
Enterprise and industrial XR integrators plus university spin-offs. Unity is the default engine; hiring volume is modest and mostly mid-level

Portugal is a major EU nearshore hub, so volume is high but Unity rates are the lowest in the country. Co-dev/porting houses and general IT service firms staffing client projects. No reliable Head-level data
Small vertical. Gamified-learning and training-content studios hire Unity devs occasionally; most PT EdTech is web/mobile-native. Pay runs ~20% below games. Single-digit sample — treat as indicative
